remarks: elcome to Whispering Pond Townhomes, where luxury and lifestyle come together. Overlooking scenic Bruce Park, this serene residence offers over 4,600 sq. ft. of beautifully designed living space with the feel of a single-family home. Enjoy an open floor plan ideal for entertaining, featuring French oak floors, a Porcelanosa gourmet kitchen, and a family room with custom cabinetry and a coffered ceiling. Upstairs are three spacious ensuite bedrooms with designer Porcelanosa baths. The rooftop deck offers breathtaking, unobstructed water views, while the lower-level media room doubles as a 4th bedroom. Complete with smart-home technology, whole-house audio, and a two-car garage. Conveniently close to train and shops.
